'''Hyperion Squad'''<ref name="IC 501st" /> was one of five [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] that served within a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]<ref name="SOBDE Squads" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> The squad consisted of four<ref name="SOBDE Squads" /> [[Commando/Legends|commandos]],<ref name="IC 501st" /> with one [[Commanding officer/Legends|leading]] as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone sergeant]].<ref name="Leadership" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the activation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the members of Hyperion Squad [[Desertion/Legends|deserted]] the [[Army/Legends|army]] and became [[Bounty/Legends|wanted]] fugitives of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, the newly appointed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered the Special Operations Brigade, now a division of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] known as the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], to hunt down the Empire's fugitives, including the members of Hyperion Squad. Looking at the list of fugitives that needed to be [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], [[Niner Skirata|IC-1309]], nicknamed "Niner," was surprised to find that Hyperion Squad had deserted the military following Order 66.<ref name="IC 501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hyperion Squad was first mentioned in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the final [[Book|novel]] in the [[Republic Commando]] series of novels, written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2009]].<ref name="IC 501st" />
